notes.title: Patch Note - 250910
notes.content: [h2]🌍 [b]New Stuff[/b][/h2][p]New [b]Color Blind Mode[/b] 🎨 — so everyone can see the world in full color (or without).[/p][p]Updated [b]loading screen[/b] with handy tips 🧠⏳.[/p][p]New [b]skyboxes[/b] (outside the demo) 🌌 — the sky, now in deluxe version.[/p][p]Some [b]mysterious post-its[/b] have appeared… or maybe not 👀[/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ [b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h2][p]Adjusted [b]translations[/b] — words that finally make sense![/p][p]Updated [b]sound for mechanical doors[/b] 🚪🔊 — clank guaranteed.[/p][p][b]Medals rebalanced[/b] 🏅 — no more rewards that were too easy (or too hard).[/p][p][b]World names updated[/b][/p][p]New [b]invert Y-axis option[/b] 🎮 — up is down, down is up, if that’s your thing.[/p]

notes.title: Rollbot Demo - Patch Notes – 250830
notes.content:
[h2]🌍 New Stuff[/h2][list][*][p]Added new languages! 🌐 Rollbot now speaks a total of [b]24 languages[/b] so even more players can join the fun:
Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Indonesian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Some Chinese characters were playing hide and seek 👀 … we found them and made them visible again![/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts were a bit shy when changing levels 👻 — now they’ll load properly and haunt your tracks as intended.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo - PatchNote - 250829
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We’ve just released a small update for the [b]demo version[/b] of the game. This patch focuses on fixing some reported issues and polishing a few details:[/p][list][*][p]🌍 Added more translations[/p][/*][*][p]👻 Fixed an issue where the player ghost was not appearing in the demo version[/p][/*][*][p]📘 Improved tutorial maps and interfaces for better clarity[/p][/*][*][p]⬇️ Fixed a bug that prevented downloading multiple ghosts at the same time[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for playing the demo and sharing your feedback — it helps us a lot in improving the game before release! 🙏[/p][p]If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to let us know on the Steam forums or our Discord Server.[/p]
